name: newsgroup-delete
description: Delete Tradebee news groups after explicit confirmation.

language.description: Required exact enabled site language selected from languages-get. Every target ID must belong to this language.

id_list.description: Required array of 1-100 positive news-group IDs selected from newsgroup-read. Send an array even for one item.

items.description: Positive news-group ID selected from newsgroup-read.

confirmation.description: Required explicit approval for the exact ID list.

approved.description: Must be true only after the user explicitly approves this operation.

summary.description: Summary of the exact language and news-group ID list approved by the user.

output.description: API result with success and failure arrays.
